name: VideoGen - AI Video Generator
original_description:
Create and edit videos in ChatGPT with VideoGen's AI video generator and AI video editor. Turn a product brief, script, or photo into an editable video with captions and an MP4 download.

Make product videos for ecommerce and DTC brands, retailers, consumer apps, agencies, and marketing teams. Create AI UGC-style ads, product demos, launch videos, and social video ads. Create videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, or landscape campaigns.

Text to video: turn a brief into a short storyboard with control over each shot. Use script to video for narrated marketing videos, explainers, lessons, or training. You can also create videos from an uploaded voiceover, PDF, or slideshow.

Image to video: animate product photos or create clips from reference images and videos. Save product, actor, and visual-style references to reuse across scenes and projects. References guide generation; exact product details and character consistency can vary.

Edit and deliver: add captions, transitions, or camera motion to an existing project. Create a separate version when you want to preserve the original. Export an MP4 and continue editing the timeline in VideoGen.

Create supporting media: AI images, video clips, voiceovers, music, sound effects, motion graphics, and avatar videos. Remove image or video backgrounds, upscale media, or turn a raster image into an SVG.

Connect your VideoGen account to start. Generation uses your VideoGen team credits and depends on your account's feature access. Uploads use the in-chat uploader where supported. VideoGen creates media and projects; it does not publish ads or manage ad campaigns. If credits or access prevent a task, open https://app.videogen.io and manage your VideoGen account, then retry.
